intro_body: There are so many ways to help bring theater and community to the Bay Area and beyond! You can [donate today](https://pyt.secure.nonprofitsoapbox.com/donate), set up [corporate sponsorship](#corporate), or [sponsor a show or a season](/ways-to-support#sponsor).
matching_note: Many employers match charitable gifts dollar-for-dollar - [search yours here to see if they do](https://pytnet.org/get-involved/matchingg).

sponsor_items.title: Center Stage Musical Show Sponsor
sponsor_items.description:
Back a single production, and receive (optional) recognition, tickets, and benefits for that title, including:

### **$350 Level**

* Thank you on screen before performances
* Acknowledgement on the playbill cover
* Donor recognition in the playbill for the entire season

### **$750 Level**

**All $350 benefits, plus**:

* Four (4) VIP tickets* to your show
* Mounted poster autographed by cast
* Optional recognition on our website

### **$1500 Level**

**All $350 and $500 benefits plus**:

* Three (3) digital downloads from PYT’s SmugMug photos
* 2 more tickets\* for a total of 6 VIP tickets\*
* VIP audition scheduling services for your next Center Stage Musical 

\*Ticket benefits have a fair market value of $36 per ticket.

sponsor_items.title: Center Stage Musicals Season Sponsor
sponsor_items.description:
Support a full season of productions across PYT, with recognition across all material, tickets and benefits:

### **$1,500 Level**

* Thank you on screen before all performances
* Acknowledgment on the playbill cover all season
* 2 tickets* for each title

### **$2,500 Level**

**All $1500 benefits, plus**:

* 2 more tickets\* for a total of 4 VIP tickets\* per title
* Mounted poster autographed by the cast for each show

### **$5,000 Level**

**All $1500 and $2500 benefits, plu**s:

* 2 more tickets\* for a total of 6 VIP tickets\* per title
* VIP audition scheduling for Center Stage Musicals
* 60 minutes of private acting or public speaking coaching
* Special recognition as a Presenting Sponsor on the program cover and PYT’s website

\*Ticket benefits have a fair market value of $36 per ticket.

sponsor_items.title: Stories on Stage Sponsor
sponsor_items.description:
[Stories on Stage](https://pyt-website.pages.dev/stories-on-stage/) (SOS) features adaptations of beloved children’s books, priced so that schools and families can afford to attend. Sponsorship is available for individual shows or the full season:

### **SOS Show Sponsor**

### **$150 Level**

* Thank you before performances
* Acknowledgement on the Stories on Stage bookmark
* Donor recognition in Center Stage Musicals playbill for the entire season

### **$350 Level**

**All $150 benefits, plus:**

* Two VIP tickets* to the Saturday public performance
* Mounted poster autographed by cast

### **$750 Level**

**All $150 and $350 benefits plus:**

* Three (3) digital downloads from PYT’s SmugMug photos
* 2 more tickets\* for a total of 4 VIP tickets\* to your Saturday public show
* VIP audition scheduling services for your next Center Stage Musical 

### **SOS Season Sponsor**

### **$1,000 Level**

* 2 tickets* to every Saturday Matinee show in the Stories on Stage Season
* Acknowledgement on lobby display
* Thanks from our director before every show
* Donor recognition in Center Stage Musicals playbill for the entire season

### **$2,500 Level**

**All $1,000 benefits plus:**

* Two additional tickets* to every Saturday Matinee show in the Stories on Stage Season
* Acknowledgement as a Presenting Sponsor on our SOS bookmarks, show posters, and website for the season

\*Ticket benefits have a fair market value of $26 per ticket.
